title: Joke Drums
blurb: Ba dum tss. The rimshot has been rescuing bad jokes since vaudeville comics worked with a live band, back when part of the drummer's job was covering for a punchline that failed to arrive on its own. Snare, then cymbal, landing a beat later than you expect. Online it survives on pure irony: nobody plays it because the joke was good, they play it because the joke was dreadful and someone has to say so. Keep it within reach for group calls, where a bad pun deserves consequences rather than laughter.
origin: A comedy rimshot sting of the kind long used by live club and variety-show drummers.
